fact: This document is the text of the Statistics Act, 2002, published in the Sierra Leone Gazette Acts Supplement of 7 November 2002 and recorded as passed in Parliament on 12 September 2002; it establishes Statistics Sierra Leone as a body corporate and repeals the Statistics Act 1963.
The Stats SL microdata catalogue entry for the 2024 Annual Agricultural Survey says respondent confidentiality is guaranteed by the Statistics Act of Sierra Leone, enacted in 2002.
The Stats SL microdata catalogue entry for the 2023 Annual Agricultural Survey says respondent confidentiality is guaranteed by the Statistics Act of Sierra Leone, enacted in 2002.

Statistics Sierra Leone says it is established by the Statistics Act 2002 as the central authority for official statistics, supervised by a Statistics Council, and that the Act guides how it deals with the public.
